meta.name: oh-my-issues
meta.description: Cluster a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into a small set of plan-master issues, redirect children with a standardized comment, and bundle architectural-fix PRs that close clusters atomically. Use when an issue tracker has accumulated dozens of reports that share underlying defects, when asked to triage / consolidate / cluster / dedupe issues, when asked to build a plan series or roadmap from open issues, or when routing a new incoming bug into an existing plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub issue 按根因聚类为计划，自动重定向子问题并打包修复 PR
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 issue 列表里堆满了重复报告，想按根因统一治理
copy.tagline_en: Cluster GitHub issues by root cause into plans, redirect children, and bundle fix PRs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your issue tracker is cluttered with duplicate reports and you want to consolidate by root cause

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会通读仓库所有打开的 issue 及其评论,按根本原因而非表面现象归组;每组建一个总览 issue 并配套设计文档,用统一留言关闭子 issue,最终把同组修复打包成一个 PR 一并关闭。
howto.when: 当仓库有 20 个以上 open issue 且疑似重复,或你要求做归类、整合、查重、从 issue 制定路线图,或想判断新 bug 是否属于已有工作时触发;少于约 15 个时不适用。

say.text: 这是新报的 bug #123,帮我判断它属于哪个已有的 plan。

howto.what_en: Claude reads all open issues, groups them by root cause (not surface), opens one plan-master issue per cluster with a design doc, closes child issues via a standardized redirect, and ships PRs that close clusters atomically.
howto.when_en: Use when a repo has 20+ open duplicated-looking issues, when you ask to triage/consolidate/cluster/dedupe issues or build a plan from them, or when a new bug should be routed into an existing plan.

say_en.text: Group the 20+ open issues by root cause and open one plan master per cluster.
say_en.note: Claude reads all issues, clusters, and creates plan masters.

say_en.text: New bug #123 — check which existing plan it belongs to.
say_en.note: Claude matches it to a master, comments, and closes it.

say_en.text: Bundle plan-02's fix into one PR that Closes #N for all children.
say_en.note: Claude verifies coverage and generates the PR description.
